enchantments.tooltip: +15 Enhancement Bonus: +15 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.
Armor-Piercing 21%: Passive: +21% Enhancement bonus to Fortification Bypass. (Fortification Bypass makes your attacks ignore a percentage of enemy Fortification.)
Piercing 6: The edges of this weapon have serrated edges, dealing an additional 6d6 piercing damage on each hit.
Insightful Doubleshot 4%: Passive: 4% Insight bonus to Doubleshot. (Doubleshot is a chance to score an additional hit with a ranged attack.)
Insightful Distant Diversion +10%: +10% Insight bonus to decreased threat generated from ranged damage.
Legendary Menechtarun Scavenger: 2 Pieces Equipped:+15 Artifact bonus to Physical and Magical Resistance Rating+30 Artifact bonus to Positive, Negative, and Repair Amplification
Mythic Weapon Boost +2 or +4: +2 or +4 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
